transport_documents.text: For these specified medicine batches M1/M2 and food batches F1/F2, shared transportation has not been validated. This run must not co-load either medicine batch with either food batch. This is carrier quality policy, not a universal statutory ban.

Vehicle0: mapped, monitored and qualified for medicine transport at+2…+8°C; food transport is separately qualified at0…+4°C. Vehicle1: monitored food qualification0…+4°C only; no medicine transport qualification. Both are refrigerated. Medicines M1/M2 require+2…+8°C; foods F1/F2 require0…+4°C.
